bullets: OpenAI has brought GPT-Live-1 into its API, adding natural back-and-forth voice agents that can listen while they speak.

bullets: Anthropic is facing a high-profile safety warning from a departing researcher as the company reportedly prepares for a possible IPO.
Nscale added former OpenAI executive Fidji Simo to its board ahead of a potential IPO, keeping leadership and capital-market activity tightly linked.
Legal and regulatory exposure is rising alongside deployment: a lawyer was fined over AI-fabricated case material, while Meta faces a suit over training data and face recognition.
The day’s market signals therefore cluster around IPO readiness, executive movement, and accountability for how AI systems are built and used.
